findings.note: RotoWire via CBS (about 7 days old) says Kincaid's passing-game role shrank for the second week in a row: 1 catch on 2 targets in Week 4, and 3 catches on 5 targets over Weeks 3-4, after a 12-catch start in Weeks 1-2.
The 2026 game log shows 5, 7, 2 and 1 catches. He went over 4.5 in two of four games, so the two early overs cut against the under even though his recent games are low.

ESPN's fantasy writeup calls Kincaid a volatile 'wild card' with a 37% snap share last season and no game over six targets in 2025. It lists him as active and notes added target competition from WR DJ Moore in 2026.
